text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takarazuka Kinen. Satono 
Diamond showed no signs of any issues with 
her condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the Tenno Sho (Spring), she 
struggled with lingering fatigue from the 
fierce battle. Because of that, she 
adjusted her schedule, prioritizing her 
recovery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, Satono Diamond meets Kitasan Black 
in the paddock and senses something amiss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sheer intensity felt from Kitasan 
Black during the Osaka Hai and Tenno Sho 
(Spring) was completely absent today...
